**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

Dear Madam
I expect to receive the Policy from the Norwich Union Office in a day or two & will then forward it to [Mrs.

Yonge ](../persons.html#1604)as you wish.

You know of course that at the present time the Policy is absolutely your property & stands in your name with the Company
I am yours faithy
[Chas Wooldridge](../persons.html#2094)
Miss Yonge
Lady Seaton’s[ Beechwood](../others.html#126) Devon
